title: Aabaad Karbala Hui Ghar Mera Lut Gaya
body:
Aabad Karbala huvi ghar mera lut gaya, Zainab hai berida sare shabbir kat gaya
Shaam-e-garibaa karti hai Zainab ajab fugaa, nalaon se hil rahe hai zameen-o-aasmaa, hai hai Hussain keh ke jo roti hai neem jaa, ran mein waha tadap ti hai lashey shah-e-zamaa
Beemaar ek ghash meinpada hai dawa nahi, kaisi dawa gareeb ko pani mila nahi, shiddat hai bukhaar pa uff tak kiya nahi, saber hai shukr karta hai lab pa gila nahi
Aawaz aayi ghodao ke tapao ki nagaha, dekha sawaar aata hai is simt be takaa, bad kar pukari kaun hai kya kaam hai yaha, waris hamare qatl huve lut gaya makaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Lekin badhaye ghodey ko aata tha wo sawar, Zainab ke pass rook liya aake rahwaar, ulti naqab chehre se utra wo shehsawar, beti ke saamne the khade shair-e-kirdigaar
Phailake haat baap se Zainab lipat gayi, roroke kehti thi meri kismat ulat gayi, baaqi jopanjetan ki nishhani thi mit gayi, baba mein apne bhai se jungle mein chut gayi
Rokar kaha Ali ne ho qurbaan ye pidar, so jao thodi dair ke hoti hai ab saher, darpaish subah ko hai tumhain Shaam ka safar, darbar mein yazeed jana hai nangey sar
Aayi sadaye Fatima fariyaad ya Ali, khaiti hamari hogayi barbaad ya Ali, mushkil kushaye khalqho dodaad ya Ali, bachao pe mere ho gayi bedaad ya Ali..
